clusters.instruction: Read the silhouette first. Then inspect the terminals.

diagnostics.playfair-display: High-contrast strokes and sharply bracketed serifs give the letters an editorial display rhythm.
diagnostics.bebas-neue: Tall, condensed capitals with compact proportions create the unmistakable poster silhouette.
diagnostics.pacifico: Connected brush-script forms and a lively forward slant separate it from the upright faces.
diagnostics.roboto-slab: A sturdy slab structure and relatively even stroke weight keep the texture robust and mechanical.

clusters.phrase: The five boxing wizards jump quickly
clusters.instruction: Look at the letter construction, not the mood.

diagnostics.bungee: Inline construction and squared display forms give the face its dimensional sign-painter character.
diagnostics.bowlby-one-sc: Rounded, oversized forms and a heavy single-storey rhythm dominate the word shape.
diagnostics.shrikhand: Dense, swelling letterforms and expressive curves produce a calligraphic display texture.
diagnostics.cinzel: Classical inscriptional capitals, sharp wedge-like details and Roman proportions define the face.

clusters.phrase: Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow
clusters.instruction: Compare stress, bracket shape and the transition into the serifs.

diagnostics.eb-garamond: Old-style proportions, moderate contrast and softly bracketed serifs keep the text colour calm.
diagnostics.libre-baskerville: A generous x-height and sturdy, readable serifs give the face a firm book-page texture.
diagnostics.cormorant-garamond: Fine hairlines, sculptural curves and elegant proportions make the texture more delicate.
diagnostics.gfs-didot: Vertical stress and extreme thick-thin contrast create a crisp Didone appearance.

clusters.instruction: The differences are small. Check the e, a, t and numeral widths.

diagnostics.inter: A tall x-height, compact spacing and carefully tuned screen proportions produce a crisp neutral texture.
diagnostics.work-sans: A condensed, utilitarian rhythm and restrained details distinguish this contemporary grotesque.
diagnostics.ibm-plex-sans: The double-storey forms and engineered curves carry a subtle technical, industrial character.
diagnostics.public-sans: Open apertures and practical proportions make the face feel neutral, direct and highly legible.

clusters.phrase: a e g t r · AVATAR
clusters.instruction: Inspect the aperture, the shoulder and the terminal on the t.

diagnostics.inter: The compact, controlled apertures and neutral terminals give the lowercase a disciplined rhythm.
diagnostics.manrope: Geometric construction with open counters and rounded joins makes the face feel more contemporary.
diagnostics.lato: Humanist proportions and warmer curves soften the overall texture compared with the geometric options.
diagnostics.work-sans: A more utilitarian construction and restrained widths make the rhythm slightly tighter.

clusters.instruction: Find the geometry in the o, then compare the joins and apertures.

diagnostics.jost: Near-circular bowls and geometric construction create a clean, rational rhythm.
diagnostics.montserrat: Wide proportions and geometric shapes give the capitals a broad, architectural stance.
diagnostics.manrope: A more balanced geometric construction and restrained spacing keep the forms compact.
diagnostics.lato: Humanist proportions, softer curves and open forms give the text a warmer reading texture.

clusters.instruction: Separate similar silhouettes by their micro-details and spacing.

diagnostics.public-sans: Open counters and broad apertures keep ambiguous pairs like rn and m distinct.
diagnostics.ibm-plex-sans: The shape of the r shoulder and the engineered numeral system provide the key clues.
diagnostics.inter: Compact spacing and tight control of the lowercase forms create a dense, even texture.
diagnostics.lato: Softer terminals and a more humanist skeleton make the lowercase rhythm easier to distinguish.

clusters.phrase: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
clusters.instruction: Recognise the visual language, then verify one diagnostic glyph.

diagnostics.cinzel: Inscriptional capitals and classical proportions evoke monumental title typography.
diagnostics.bungee: Layered inline forms and solid geometry give the letters a sign-painted dimensional effect.
diagnostics.bebas-neue: A narrow, towering silhouette is the defining feature of this condensed display face.
diagnostics.playfair-display: The high contrast and elegant serif details create a distinctly editorial voice.

clusters.triviaTitle: A typeface is a cultural shortcut
clusters.triviaNote: Display faces carry visual associations before a word is even read. Film titles, posters and album covers use that recognition to establish a world in a fraction of a second.

clusters.phrase: Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs
clusters.instruction: The last specimen rewards instinct and a final close inspection.

diagnostics.bowlby-one-sc: The broad, soft, heavy forms create an unusually dense block of display lettering.
diagnostics.shrikhand: Calligraphic swelling and unusual curves distinguish this expressive display face.
diagnostics.bungee: The inline construction, squared counters and sign-painter proportions are the giveaway.
diagnostics.bebas-neue: The very narrow width and tall capitals create a compressed poster rhythm.

clusters.triviaTitle: Poster lettering is built for distance
clusters.triviaNote: Display type is often designed to survive a glance, not a long read. Width, weight and counter shape help a title remain recognisable from across a room.
